idea-plugin.name: BZ-Cyberpunk
idea-plugin.description:
A neon-noir dark theme inspired by the UI of Cyberpunk 2077 and the look of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners.

  • Indigo-black backgrounds with HUD red selections, yellow focus/caret accents and netrunner cyan.
  • Edgerunners magenta, acid green and braindance violet in the syntax palette.
  • Full Java highlighting (records, enums, type parameters, annotations, static imports, Javadoc), plus Kotlin, Python, Rust, web languages, Markdown, the console and the debugger.
  • Two variants: BZ-Cyberpunk for the new UI and BZ-Cyberpunk Islands for the Islands UI (2025.3+).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.0.0
  • New palette taken from Cyberpunk 2077 (HUD red, signature yellow, netrunner cyan) and Cyberpunk: Edgerunners (magenta, acid green, violet), on indigo-tinted near-black backgrounds.
  • Rebuilt the editor color scheme with explicit Java support and consistent diff, VCS, debugger, inlay hint and inspection colors.
  • The theme now inherits from the new UI Dark theme and recolors its palette, so newer UI components match.
  • Added an Islands variant for IntelliJ 2025.3 and later.
  • Requires IntelliJ-based IDEs 2023.3 or later. There is no upper version limit.
